# PRC 13 Roofing Inc.

PRC 13 Roofing Inc. is a service-area roofing contractor based in Sacramento, California. The company serves homeowners and light commercial properties across the greater Sacramento region. PRC 13 Roofing does not currently promote a public storefront office address; service coverage is defined by its Sacramento-area service areas.

Related service coverage:
- Roof repair includes leak repair, storm damage repair, flat roof repair, shingle repair, and flashing repair.
- Metal roofing includes metal roof installation, metal roof replacement, and standing seam roofing.
- Roof inspections include maintenance inspections, annual roof maintenance, and preventative maintenance guidance.
